eligibility.evidence: Abstract and Sections 1-3 (p.19433): builds a fallacy-detection benchmark (Reddit posts plus Prolog-generated statements) and scores nine LLMs on detection and categorisation; no cognitive-psychology paradigm or human study is cited, no human comparison.

A.title: Socrates or Smartypants: Testing Logic Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models with Logic Programming-Based Test Oracles
A.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-26)

G.notes: Logic-fallacy benchmark with generation framework; fails E2 provenance (no paradigm from the cognitive literature) and has no human comparison. A referee might ask whether fallacy classification counts as a reasoning paradigm; judged benchmark-only.
